body_markdown:
Boat storage at Public Storage helps you free up room in your driveway, garage, or side yard when your boat is not in use. Many Public Storage locations offer outdoor parking for boats and trailers, including covered and uncovered spaces.


## Key Takeaways


- Public Storage offers covered and uncovered outdoor boat parking at participating locations.
- [Up-to-35-foot spaces](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide/vehicle-storage-unit-35-feet/vehicle-storage-unit-35-feet.html) fit many boats, while up-to-50-foot spaces may fit larger boats and trailers.
- Boat and RV storage rentals are available month-to-month.
- Measure the full length, width, and height of the boat and trailer before selecting a space.
- A 35-foot space may be as large as 10 feet wide by 35 feet long, though dimensions vary by location.


## What Types of Boat Storage Does Public Storage Offer?


Public Storage offers[outdoor vehicle parking](https://www.publicstorage.com/vehicle-car-rv-storage) that may fit boats and boat trailers:


- **Uncovered outdoor parking spaces:** Open-air parking in a dedicated fenced area. This option can work well for seasonal storage or regular outings.
- **Covered parking spaces:** Parking spaces with overhead coverage can help reduce direct sun exposure and moderate climate effects.


Boat and RV parking options vary by location. Not every facility offers covered parking, uncovered parking, or boat storage, so customers can[search nearby locations](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-search) and review current availability before reserving.


## Are Enclosed Boat Storage Units Available?


Public Storage’s boat and RV storage spaces are outdoor parking options. The 35-foot boat and RV storage guidance notes that enclosed indoor RV and boat storage units are not offered for these larger vehicle spaces.


Some Public Storage locations may offer enclosed vehicle units for certain vehicle types and sizes, but boat owners can check directly with a nearby facility to confirm whether a particular boat-and-trailer combination fits an available space.


## What Size Boat Storage Space Do I Need?


The best boat storage size depends on the complete dimensions of the boat and trailer. Measure from the front of the trailer tongue to the end of the motor or other extended equipment before reserving. Also review the boat’s width and height, especially when considering covered parking.


**Space Size** **Typical Fit**


**Up to 20 feet** Some smaller boats and trailers, depending on exact dimensions


**Up to 35 feet** Many RVs and boats, including Class A and Class 1 boats


**Up to 50 feet** Larger boats, trailers, campers, motorhomes, and some commercial vans or trucks


A 35-foot boat and RV parking space can be as large as 10 feet wide by 35 feet long, providing up to 350 square feet of parking space. A boat trailer that fits within those dimensions may have room on each side for parking. Exact dimensions vary by facility.


For larger boats, select locations may offer spaces up to[50 feet long](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide/vehicle-storage-unit-50-feet/vehicle-storage-unit-50-feet.html) .


## What Boats May Fit in a 35-Foot Space?


A 35-foot parking space may fit a boat and trailer that remain within the space’s listed dimensions. Public Storage identifies Class A and Class 1 boats—generally under 26 feet long—as examples that can fit in a 35-foot space with room to spare. Some smaller Class 2 boats may fit as well, depending on their full trailer length.


Before reserving, include these measurements:


- Trailer tongue
- Boat hull
- Motor and propeller area
- Swim platform or other extended equipment
- Trailer width
- Boat height, if choosing covered parking


## How Do You Prepare a Boat for Storage?


A simple storage checklist can help you organize your boat between trips:


1. **Clean the boat and trailer.** Wash away dirt, salt, sap, and debris from the exterior. Clean the interior and remove food, crumbs, wet gear, and other items that may attract pests.
2. **Dry interior areas.** Tidy seating, storage compartments, and floor surfaces before putting the boat away.
3. **Pack away removable gear.** Organize life jackets, ropes, dock lines, and other boating equipment so it is easy to find before the next outing.
4. **Check the trailer.** Confirm the boat is properly positioned on its trailer before parking.
5. **Review vehicle condition.** Boats and other vehicles stored at Public Storage must be in working condition.
6. **Consider a boat cover.** A cover can help reduce exposure to the elements in either covered or uncovered outdoor parking.
7. **Measure before reserving.** Include the trailer tongue, motor, and any extended equipment in the measurement.


## Why Use Offsite Boat Storage?


Offsite boat storage can declutter space at home when a boat or trailer is not in use. It also gives boat owners a dedicated place to park seasonal equipment rather than using a driveway or garage year-round.


Public Storage boat and RV storage rentals are month-to-month, offering flexibility for a season, a longer break between outings, or an ongoing storage plan.


Customers can access their space during property gate hours, and the boat remains where it was parked for convenient pickup.


Each parking space is designed for one vehicle. Customers with more than one boat, RV, or trailer may rent multiple spaces, based on local availability.


## How Do You Reserve Boat Storage at Public Storage?


1. Search for a nearby Public Storage location.
2. Select **Vehicle Units** in the storage search.
3. Compare available covered and uncovered parking options.
4. Confirm the boat-and-trailer length, width, and height fit the listed space.
5. Reserve online.


## Boat Storage FAQs


**Can I store a boat trailer at Public Storage?**


Yes. Participating Public Storage locations offer vehicle spaces that may fit boats with trailers. Up-to-35-foot and up-to-50-foot options may be available, depending on the property.


**Is covered boat storage available?**


Some Public Storage locations offer covered outdoor parking. These spaces have overhead coverage that can help reduce direct sun exposure and moderate climate effects.


**Are enclosed boat storage units available?**


Public Storage’s RV and boat storage options are outdoor parking spaces. For a specific boat-and-trailer setup, check with a nearby property for current space options and dimensions.


**How long can I rent boat storage?**


Boat and RV storage rentals are available month-to-month.


**Can I access my boat after storing it?**


Customers can access their rented space during the property’s gate hours. Access hours vary by location.


**What affects boat storage pricing?**


Boat storage pricing can vary based on location, space size, availability, and amenities. Covered parking generally costs more than uncovered parking, and larger spaces generally cost more than smaller spaces.


**Can I store more than one vehicle in a boat storage space?**


No. Covered and uncovered boat and RV parking spaces are designed for one vehicle. Multiple spaces may be available to rent at the same property.


## Reserve Boat Storage Near You


Whether you are putting away a fishing boat between seasons or organizing space in the garage, Public Storage offers covered and uncovered boat parking options at participating locations. Measure your boat and trailer, compare nearby locations, and reserve a space that fits your plans.
